asset.name: ResponsiveDialog
asset.description: The adaptive overlay presenting as a centered dialog on pointer-first desktops and as a sheet or full-height drawer on constrained or touch-first viewports, without losing open state across the change.

requires.reason: Desktop presentation is the shared dialog.
Constrained presentation is the shared sheet.
Presentation selection is a behavioral breakpoint, not a style one.

rationale: One of the two assets that carry a DESIGN.md responsive transformation as its own contract: modal becomes sheet. Preserving open state across the breakpoint is the part that is easy to get wrong and invisible until a device rotates.
